feeds.title: Eurovision Radio International
feeds.description: Welcome to Radio International - the Ultimate Eurovision Experience. It is the legendary Eurovision radio show broadcast to the many Eurovision Fans around the World hosted by JP and his International Team. The show is live every Wednesday from 7-11pm CET via the SWITCH Radio Network in the UK and on the show's Facebook Group Page - Eurovision Radio International. For more radio stations broadcasting Radio International see HOW TO LISTEN below. To all HAPPY EUROVISIONING!

feeds.title: ESCUnited
feeds.description: Since our humble beginnings as a dedicated Eurovision fan forum and then becoming one of the largest online communities for fans of the contest, ESC United as we know it was created by Matt Friedrichs and Zack Kerr in time for the 2013 contest in Malmö. Since then, we have gone from strength to strength and grown as a community-focused website and YouTube channel with an emphasis on passionate yet balanced discussion, analysis, and commentary on Europe's longest-running competition.

feeds.title: AussieVision
feeds.description: Aussievision began in 2017 as a podcast recorded with just an iPhone and enthusiasm for all things Australia at Eurovision. Since then it has grown into a news site, global podcast, and social media presence bringing everything associated with the Eurovision Song Contest. Aussievision operates year-round, covering the Contest itself, the national finals, as well as other Eurovision and Australian music artist news throughout the off-season.

feeds.title: OnEurope
feeds.description: The Eurovision Song Contest 2023 is the upcoming 67th edition of the Eurovision Song Contest. It takes place in Liverpool, United Kingdom, after Ukraine, winner of the 2022 contest with the song 'Stefania' by Kalush Orchestra, was unable to meet the demands of hosting the event due to security concerns caused by the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

feeds.title: EurovisionFun
feeds.description: Our slogan is EuroFantastic News and we all work hard to deliver you the finest taste of what's happening inside the Eurovision Bubble. My name is Giannis Argyriou and I live in the beautiful city of Thessaloniki. Since I was a kid I liked journalism, although I decided to study law and work as a lawyer. Through my love of music and Eurovision, I managed to 'journalize', even in this way.

feeds.title: Ilkar Blogilkar
feeds.description: All about Finnish pop, Eurovision song contest and Sanremo festival, il festival della canzone italiana di Sanremo. And more.

feeds.title: ESCplus
feeds.description: European music coverage! Daily news about the Eurovision Song Contest, interviews, former participants, photos, exclusive reports and new features!

feeds.title: EurovisionIreland
feeds.description: This is the Official Irish Eurovision Blog. We will keep you up to date with all the news for Ireland at Eurovision. We will give you exclusive updates on both the Eurosong Finalists and the road to the Eurovision Finals including Eurovision Voting Predictions, Interactive Polls, ESC Contestant interviews, and song Videos.

feeds.title: Eurovoix
feeds.description: Launched on May 1st, 2011, Eurovoix has grown to become one of the leading sources of entertainment news tailored towards the European music scene and international song contests, including detailed coverage of 'Eurovision' events. Throughout the year it provides a reliable and prompt response to the very latest stories as and when they happen; allowing an active, global audience to follow their favorite events, and discover new talents.

feeds.title: The Eurovision Times
feeds.description: The Eurovision Times is an independent and completely non-profitable fan blog about the Eurovision Song Contest. The blog focuses a lot on national finals and the contest's history. Rumors and gossip are discussed at length, as any good fan site, but this is a place with a sense of community, where people's opinions are valued and where conversation and debate are welcomed most of all!

feeds.title: ESC Insight
feeds.description: Welcome to the Eurovision website that takes a closer look at Europe's favorite TV show. It was first set up in 2010 following the success of Ewan Spence's Unofficial Eurovision Song Contest Podcast during the 2008 and 2009 Song Contests to provide the audio show with its own home.

feeds.title: ESCToday
feeds.description: It all started back in 1998 when Mr. Sietse Bakker decided to launch a website that will fill up the gap of missing information about the preparations for the Eurovision Song Contest. Since then ESCToday has walked a long distance of almost 20 years online. Under his wings, the site grew into the most popular independent Eurovision news website.

feeds.title: ESCXTRA
feeds.description: ESCXTRA brings you closer to the Eurovision Song Contest. We post new content daily and keep you up to date on your favorite topic.

feeds.title: EurovisionWorld
feeds.description: Eurovisionworld is a private fan community for everyone who has a passion for Eurovision Song Contest. All articles, pictures, facts, videos, polls, etc. have only one focus, Eurovision Song Contest! We will bring you all the Eurovision stories around the world, in a beautifully simple format. Together with all the news articles, we aim to serve you all the other aspects of the Eurovision Song Contest.

feeds.title: Wiwibloggs
feeds.description: Established in 2009, wiwibloggs is the world's most-visited independent website devoted to the Eurovision Song Contest. Recognizing that Eurovision is not just a one-night event, we provide daily news and analysis on Eurovision and its artists, both past and present, and the broader europop scene.

feeds.title: Eurovision Song Reviews
feeds.description: My love affair with the Eurovision Song Contest began in 1971, the year that The United Kingdom sent Clodagh Rodgers to Ireland with 'Jack in a Box'. To cut a long story short, that is how I arrived here at this blog, combining my fascination with the contest and my love for languages and the written word.

feeds.title: Eurovision Through The Ages
feeds.description: A blog about the Eurovision Song Contest, past and present, from a Brit's perspective.

feeds.title: ESC Armchair
feeds.description: Hello there! My name is Ann, I'm in my forties, originally from Liverpool (but lived in the Somerset area for many many years) married in 2012, and currently nursing a six-year-old headache called Marcus! Eurovision is a big part of my life and I've been able to converse with a lot of great Eurofans on twitter. All of who have become the nearest thing to real friends. It means a lot. Eurovision may well just be a song contest but sometimes it feels like my greatest connection to humankind.

feeds.title: Six on Stage Blog
feeds.description: This blog accompanies Six on Stage, a website about the performers of the Eurovision Song Contest. Although this is a Eurovision blog (written by me, Will - hi), the focus is on objective lists, data, and nerdy stuff like that.

feeds.title: BBC Eurovision Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the official BBC Eurovision blog. Keep up to date with all of the very latest news about the UK delegation and Eurovision Song Contest here.

feeds.title: Eurovision Apocalypse
feeds.description: Eurovision Apocalypse is here to dredge the best (and occasionally worst) of them out of the musical nether regions, as well as some of the other greatest oddities the contest has thrown up over the last fifty-odd years.

feeds.title: EuroVisionary
feeds.description: Welcome to EuroVisionary - a website dedicated to the Eurovision Song Contest, its national finals, and current as well as previous participants. WE publish reliable news you can count on, In-depth articles, and 2D and 3D videos... all from the world of Eurovision.

feeds.title: ESCDaily
feeds.description: ESCDaily covers Eurovision like the Olympic Games of Music. Find articles, the latest news, and more.

feeds.title: That Eurovision Site
feeds.description: 'THAT Eurovision Site' would not exist without the work of its members, who are working to ensure that they bring you Eurovision coverage with a slice of life! Despite only launching in Early 2021, our site consists of 10 members, spanning all over the world from the USA to Australia.

feeds.title: Pif Paf Blog
feeds.description: Pif Paf Blog writes about the Eurovision song genre, the latest news, and more. It does not follow the company time.
